scope_notes: All regular files were byte-read and SHA-256 hashed without following symlinks.
JSON and JSONL outside dependency/cache trees were parsed; text was keyword-scanned or structure-read.

Semantic aggregation selects canonical attempt representations: external-context result.json receipts, GLM visible-trace receipts, and completed glm-fitting JSONL rows. Copies such as captures/responses/checkpoints are inventoried but excluded from token totals.
Shared request digests do not collapse attempts; attempt identity is path plus episode/invocation.
